audit_log_actor_chk.name: audit_log_actor_chk
audit_log_actor_chk.value: ("audit_log"."actor_type" = 'user' and "audit_log"."actor_user_id" is not null) or ("audit_log"."actor_type" = 'system' and "audit_log"."actor_user_id" is null and "audit_log"."actor_user_profile_id" is null)

audit_log_entity_chk.name: audit_log_entity_chk
audit_log_entity_chk.value: "audit_log"."entity_id" is null or "audit_log"."entity_type" is not null

patient_identity_verification_pending_ke.name: patient_identity_verification_pending_keys_chk
patient_identity_verification_pending_ke.value: "patient_identity_verification"."status" <> 'pending' or ("patient_identity_verification"."ine_front_object_key" is not null and "patient_identity_verification"."ine_back_object_key" is not null)

patient_identity_verification_deleted_ke.name: patient_identity_verification_deleted_keys_chk
patient_identity_verification_deleted_ke.value: "patient_identity_verification"."documents_deleted_at" is null or ("patient_identity_verification"."ine_front_object_key" is null and "patient_identity_verification"."ine_back_object_key" is null)

medication_order_delivery_chk.name: medication_order_delivery_chk
medication_order_delivery_chk.value: ("medication_order"."delivery_method" = 'pickup' and "medication_order"."organization_id" is not null) or ("medication_order"."delivery_method" = 'home_delivery' and "medication_order"."shipping_address" is not null)

payment_type_reference_chk.name: payment_type_reference_chk
payment_type_reference_chk.value: ("payment"."type" = 'consultation' and "payment"."appointment_id" is not null) or ("payment"."type" = 'medication' and "payment"."medication_order_id" is not null)

doctor_payout_adjustment_creator_chk.name: doctor_payout_adjustment_creator_chk
doctor_payout_adjustment_creator_chk.value: ("doctor_payout_adjustment"."created_by_type" = 'user' and "doctor_payout_adjustment"."created_by_user_id" is not null) or ("doctor_payout_adjustment"."created_by_type" = 'system' and "doctor_payout_adjustment"."created_by_user_id" is null)

support_request_reference_chk.name: support_request_reference_chk
support_request_reference_chk.value: "support_request"."medication_order_id" is not null or "support_request"."appointment_id" is not null
